title: Wear a Helmet
tip: Always wear a properly fitted helmet when riding your e-bike.

title: Use Bike Lights
tip: Use a bright front light and a red rear light when riding at night.

title: Stay Visible
tip: Wear reflective clothing and use lights to make yourself visible to drivers.

title: Check Your Brakes
tip: Inspect your brakes regularly and make sure they respond correctly before riding.

title: Check Your Tires
tip: Check tire pressure and look for damage before starting a delivery shift.

title: Watch for Traffic
tip: Stay alert and watch for vehicles, pedestrians, and other cyclists.

title: Follow Traffic Laws
tip: Follow traffic signals, signs, and bicycle laws while making deliveries.

title: Avoid Distracted Riding
tip: Do not use your phone while your e-bike is moving.

title: Ride Carefully in Rain
tip: Reduce your speed and increase your stopping distance on wet roads.

title: Protect Your Battery
tip: Keep your battery dry and follow the manufacturer's charging instructions.

title: Plan Your Route
tip: Check your route before riding and choose safer streets whenever possible.

title: Keep Both Hands Ready
tip: Keep both hands available for controlling the bicycle whenever possible.

title: Slow Down at Intersections
tip: Reduce your speed near intersections and check carefully for turning vehicles.

title: Take Regular Breaks
tip: Take breaks during long delivery shifts to maintain concentration and energy.

title: Secure Your E-Bike
tip: Use a strong lock and secure your e-bike whenever you leave it unattended.
